=== enter between braces
--- before
{¦}
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
{
    ¦
}

=== enter between brackets
--- before
[¦]
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
[
    ¦
]

=== autoclose key
--- before
{¦}
--- keys
"a
--- after
{"a¦"}

=== overtype quote
--- before
{¦}
--- keys
"a": 1
--- after
{"a": 1¦}

=== nested object
--- before
{
    "a": ¦
}
--- keys
{<enter>
--- after
{
    "a": {
        ¦
    }
}

=== electric closer
--- before
{
    "a": 1
    ¦
--- keys
}
--- after
{
    "a": 1
}¦

=== no autoclose in string
--- before
{"a¦": 1}
--- keys
[
--- after
{"a[¦": 1}

=== backspace pair
--- before
[¦]
--- keys
{<bs>
--- after
[¦]

=== surround
--- before
[«1»]
--- keys
[
--- after
[[«1»]]

=== comma then enter
--- before
[
    1,¦
]
--- keys
<enter>2
--- after
[
    1,
    2¦
]
